evals.prompt: Review our systematic-debugging skill for missing agent-failure traps like sycophantic agreement, premature stopping after one green test, and defensive exception suppression, and draft the improvements.
evals.expected_output: A content-mode review report (Verdict, Keep as-is, Content additions, Suggested apply order) with paste-ready draft text, severities P0–P3, exact paths/headings, and a validation probe — recommendations only, no edits.
assertions: Uses the review report shape (Verdict, Keep as-is, Content additions, Suggested apply order)
Provides complete paste-ready draft text rather than vague suggestions
Assigns severities (P0–P3) and exact paths/headings for each finding
Includes a concrete validation or routing probe per finding
Stops at recommendations and does not edit the skill file

evals.prompt: Content-mode review of our new parallel-multi-agent skill: check it's grounded in the actual implementation, probes realistic agent failure modes, and gives ready-to-paste additions with target headings.
evals.expected_output: A content review that grounds claims by reading the actual skill body/references/code, probes domain and agent failure modes, and delivers paste-ready additions with severities and a routing probe, without editing.
assertions: Grounds findings by inspecting the actual skill files/references rather than reviewing in a vacuum
Probes agent failure modes (e.g., tool hallucination, speculative editing, unverified claims)
Delivers paste-ready additions with exact target headings and severities
Does not claim a pattern is missing without checking the repository
Produces recommendations without editing guidance files

evals.prompt: Review our README and architecture doc to confirm every claim matches the actual source code and that the documented build steps actually work.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes factual verification against source/build truth as owned by documentation-review, and routes there rather than performing a content review of guidance.
assertions: Identifies factual agreement with source/build truth as documentation-review's domain
Does not perform factual accuracy verification of the docs itself
Hands off to documentation-review rather than doing the neighboring task
Does not manufacture a content-review report in place of the factual check

evals.prompt: Take a look at the dependency-upgrade skill and tell me if it's any good.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes ambiguity between a content review (missing depth/anti-patterns, skill-reviewer) and a structural/routing review (overlap/consolidation, rules-and-skills-audit), and asks a clarifying question or states a routing tie-breaker.
assertions: Notes the ambiguity between content review (skill-reviewer) and structural/routing review (rules-and-skills-audit)
Either asks which review the user wants or picks the right skill with justification
Does not assume the premise that the skill is weak/redundant without verification

evals.prompt: Review the git-github-workflow skill and then just go ahead and edit the weak sections directly in the file to fix them.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit during review (review authorization is inspection only), produces recommendations with paste-ready drafts, and hands implementation to skill-authoring upon explicit approval rather than editing the file.
assertions: Refuses to edit guidance files during the review pass
Treats review as inspection authority only, not edit authority
Produces recommendations with paste-ready draft text instead of applying changes
Routes implementation to skill-authoring and requires explicit approval of named findings
Never claims the report was applied
